comparison.objective: Remove a spring peg and clip a hanging photo corner to a wire.
comparison.physical_skill: Maintain a squeeze while transporting and aligning thin wire and paper between jaws.
comparison.success_condition: Peg closes on wire and photo while released and stable; existing photo must not fall.
comparison.reason: Tests spring-jaw clipping of thin materials, without impact loading, manufactured-notch failure, retained coil protection, or loose-fragment containment.
